title: Machinery and equipment
description: Registry, shift journal, service and cost of work
emptyBody: Add tractors, seeders, pumps and other equipment: each gets its own cost center.
deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. A machine with history cannot be deleted: write it off instead.

fields.name: Name
fields.salvageHint: Value left at the end of its life
fields.openingDepreciationHint: What had already worn off when the farm came onto this system
fields.openingDepreciationDateHint: Months up to this date are in the figure and are not posted again
fields.motoHoursHint: Current reading; shifts are added automatically
fields.rentedHint: Hired service: no depreciation, paid by acceptance act

usage.hoursHint: Hours this shift, not the meter reading
usage.skipFuelHint: For example, the contractor brought it
usage.deleteBody: Motor-hours are taken back and the fuel returns to the warehouse.
usage.emptyBody: Log motor-hours, area done and fuel for every shift.

maintenance.paymentHint: If chosen, the expense is recorded in finance
maintenance.deleteBody: Spare parts used go back to the warehouse.
maintenance.emptyBody: Record planned service and repairs: you will be reminded when the next one is due.

costs.noDepreciationBody: It is posted automatically at the start of each month.

depreciation.confirmBody: Every ended month not posted yet goes to the books as a non-cash cost of each machine. A month already posted is not posted again.
depreciation.nothingBody: No ended month has anything left to post. {{month}} can be posted once it has ended.

rental.hint: Unbilled shifts of the period become a debt to the contractor and are charged to the fields.
